entries.name: Arthur Barber

expected.charges: Felony murder, attempted first-degree robbery and conspiracy
expected.sentence: Life imprisonment; released in 1975 after nearly ten years in custody when a federal court invalidated the coerced confession.

entries.rationale: Arnold H. Lubasch, New York Times September 11, 1975, page 47, transcribed by Victims of the State, explicitly reports police seized Barber December 19, 1965. Refines existing year-only arrest and custody start. Existing 1975 year-only release is retained but not independently verified: contemporaneous article gives a conditional release-or-retrial order, not physical discharge; Rosenbaum NYU law review page 811 cites January 9, 1976 dismissal certificate. Neither reversal nor dismissal is substituted for release.
